item.title: Wed 30 Sep 2026: Long yields at 24-year highs, BoE pauses gilt sales, FCA crypto gateway opens, fund M&A wave
item.description: Wall Street slips for a second day as the 30-year Treasury yield hits its highest since 2002 and US consumer confidence falls to a 12-year low; the Bank of England is reported to pause gilt sales ahead of the 28 October budget. Regulation: the FCA cryptoasset application window opens, the UK AIFM regime consultation runs to 22 October, and Ombudsman changes start on 1 October. Funds: T. Rowe Price, Victory Capital and Vanguard deals point to a consolidation wave, plus three COO action points.

item.title: Tue 29 Sep 2026: Yields hit cycle highs, Hormuz oil shock, FCA CFD crackdown, Apollo gates again
item.description: US 10-year above 5.25% and gilts near two-decade highs; Brent at $107 after the US rejects Iran's Hormuz plan; BoE's 6-3 hold and November hike pricing; Lagarde on measured hikes before Friday's flash HICP. Regulation: FCA CFD crackdown, FOS changes from 1 October, Form PF delayed to July 2027, SEC pay-to-play rescission, frontier AI and operational resilience. Funds: Apollo Debt Solutions caps redemptions, AllianceBernstein names Onur Erzan CEO, active ETF hires and launches. Plus three COO action points.
